caution_findings.evidence_context: The packet linked_sequence_records.jsonl is empty, so sequence identity was checked against the merged DBAASP sequence catalog plus primary Table 1.
The primary paper reports MIC 32 μM for SmAPα1-21, but the linked DBAASP assay snapshot only includes assay rows for DBAASPS_17936 and DBAASPS_17937.
The synthesis method used Rink Amide resin, while Table 1 and DBAASP sequence strings list plain one-letter peptide sequences; terminal chemistry is preserved as a caution, not silently normalized.
The local paper and supplement reviewed here do not report host toxicity or hemolysis endpoints for these peptides.
PI uptake and TEM support membrane/cell-wall-associated effects, but the exact binding target or pathway remains unresolved in the primary paper.
